description.value: Cedarbrook Bakery & Deli is a neighbourhood bakery and deli in Langley, BC, baking fresh bread, cheese buns, donuts, and other goods in-store daily. The deli counter carries a wide selection of cured meats and cheeses, and the shop also offers gluten-free baked goods for cyclists with dietary restrictions. Customer reviews highlight friendly staff and high-quality food, making it a welcoming stop on a ride through the Langley area.
